A particle P of mass 0.2 kg is moving in a circle of radius 0.5 m. At time t s its velocity is
t + ct + d m s , where c and d are constants. The magnitude of the resultant force acting on
P when t = 3 is 17 N. The transverse component of the acceleration of P when t = 3 is 2 m s .
Find the values of c and d. [8]
